fact: At the 30 September 2026 deadline set by the BCEAO, Wave and Moov Money joined PI-SPI, so Cote d'Ivoire's four main mobile wallets are connected and authorised participants rose from 23 to 38.
title: Paiement instantane : Wave et Moov Money rejoignent la plateforme de la BCEAO, la Cote d'Ivoire passe a 38 acteurs connectes
